_primary_metric_hint: The one number THIS engine optimises : commonly clicks from Search Console. A channel can still override it in shared/channels.json.
_published_dir_hint: Where this engine's shipped artifacts go. Empty = the default, <home>/published/<this-engine>/. Accepts a home-relative path or an absolute one (an external drive, a synced folder, a shared team drive). Set to "none" to skip the copy and leave artifacts in runs/<run_id>/output/.
_comment: This folder is fully self-contained: its own experiments, sources, templates, inputs, runs and reports. Want a second seo engine with a different goal or audience? Copy this whole folder to a new name (e.g. seo-partners/), rewrite this file's goal and metric, and run it independently. The folder name is the engine name; 'type' maps it to the engine-seo skill.
